video.title: AI欧腐《我的龙崽藏不住了/My Dragon Cubs Can't Stay Hidden》
video.desc:
我不行了 小龙崽太可爱了
At a masquerade, Rhyan spends one wild night with Calenor, never knowing he's the Dragon Lord. He wakes up terrified and runs... only to later give birth to three dragonlings with an appetite for gold and diamonds. Four years later, feeding them has left Rhyan broke, so he takes a high-paying job as a sound therapist. His new client? Calenor, the man he ran out on. Now Rhyan's hiding their three kids under Calenor's own roof... but the little troublemakers are determined to find their Papa.
在一场假面舞会上，Rhyan 与 Calenor 度过了一夜疯狂，却完全不知道对方正是龙王本人。他惊慌醒来后仓皇逃走——却没想到后来生下了三只专爱吞金食钻的小龙崽。四年后，养育这三个"小吞金兽"让 Rhyan 彻底破产，他不得不接下一份高薪工作，成为一名音疗师。而他的新客户，正是 Calenor——那个被他当年抛下逃走的男人。如今 Rhyan 只能一边在 Calenor 的屋檐下藏起他们的三个孩子，一边提心吊胆……可这几个调皮的小麻烦，正铁了心要找到他们的爸爸。
